note: 5DC-v1A-Daily-Pullback Primary variant. A2a daily OHLCV proxy of 5DC's uptrend+CCI-pullback logic. Not the full 5DC (no intraday DMI/wedge/MTF).

signal.expression: Close[t] > BB_mid[t] AND CCI[t-1] <= -100 AND CCI[t] > -100

risk.atrReferenceDate: t (signal date) - never t+1 or later
risk.timeExitRule: close of the 60th tradable session counting entry_date as session 1

gapRule: fill at session Open if Open already through stop_price

universe.coverageNote: missingPriceTickers ~19% of A1a+A1b (734/3801, real A2b run 2026-08-24) - a chunk of delisted names have zero price trace by construction (mirrors GATE-EP-1's own finding), not a fixable gap. PRIMARY does not require 100% coverage; the gap is reported in diag.universeCoverage instead.
